sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF is a 9 billion parameter language model created by Qwen and quantized to GGUF format by the lmstudio-community team using llama.cpp release b8185. This model performs general-purpose text-to-text tasks including instruction following, reasoning, and dialogue.
